name: rebuilt-sections
title: Rebuilt Sections
description: Custom-built marketing sections for navigation, authentication, and pricing decisions.
useWhen: You need a clear marketing section that leads visitors toward one understandable next step.
avoidWhen: The section requires product-specific business logic that belongs in the consuming app.
responsiveBehavior: Sections collapse into a single readable column while preserving action prominence and content order.
accessibility: Navigation uses landmarks and visible focus states.
Forms and pricing actions retain meaningful labels and heading hierarchy.

variants.title: Navigation
variants.description: A restrained marketing navigation with one clear primary action and a compact responsive rhythm.
accessibility: Use a navigation landmark and a labelled menu toggle on small screens.

variants.title: Authentication layout
variants.description: A focused sign-in frame that gives the form priority while keeping supporting context quiet.
accessibility: Associate labels and errors with their controls and keep the submit action explicit.

variants.title: Pricing
variants.description: A comparison section with one emphasized plan, short benefit groups, and an obvious decision path.
accessibility: Do not communicate plan differences with color alone; retain visible names and values.
